title: Agent Skill Report
top_findings: Four of eleven sessions burned over 120 tool calls each to answer one question, and none of them opened the relevant source file first. The 4cd5a757 rtk-install session spent 121 calls with 22 failing probes; d810570c spent 161 calls with 37. A single targeted read of the install doc or the sidebar source would have collapsed both.

The installed DSH skill catalog is invisible to four of these sessions. 51 skills are installed (2 project, 49 preset) yet only 5 sessions invoked one, and three sessions that needed one — 4cd5a757 for setup, 84df625b for sidebar work, d810570c for investigation — ran with 'skills detected: (none)'.

Long sessions are steered, not self-correcting: 0cb48c56 took 34 user turns and 17 repeated tool calls to finish a prototype, and 84df625b took 7 user turns with 229 calls. The work landed in both cases, but the user supplied the direction the agent did not derive.

suggestions.change: Add a trigger line for install/setup questions so the skill fires before trial-and-error probing.
suggestions.evidence: Session 4cd5a757 ('dsh 怎么安装 rtk') ran 121 tool calls with 22 error-ish outputs and detected no skill, on a question the dsh-knowledge chapter index covers directly. Efficiency 0.4.

suggestions.change: Default DSH runs to the skill roots DSH actually resolves, not every harness home, so skill_coverage is not diluted by unloadable skills.
